option_relations.rationale: The option 'Paraneoplastic arthritis secondary to lung adenocarcinoma' is a broader category that encompasses the specific diagnosis of 'ALK-positive lung adenocarcinoma (right upper lobe) with paraneoplastic polyarthritis, stage IV (metastatic)'.

The option 'Paraneoplastic Polyarthritis associated with lung cancer' is a broader category that encompasses the specific diagnosis of 'ALK-positive lung adenocarcinoma (right upper lobe) with paraneoplastic polyarthritis, stage IV (metastatic)'.

The option 'Paraneoplastic polyarthritis' is a broader category that encompasses the specific diagnosis of 'ALK-positive lung adenocarcinoma (right upper lobe) with paraneoplastic polyarthritis, stage IV (metastatic)'.

The option 'ALK-positive lung adenocarcinoma with paraneoplastic RS3PE (Remitting Seronegative Symmetrical Synovitis with Pitting Edema)' is clinically equivalent to the leaf 'ALK-positive lung adenocarcinoma (right upper lobe) with paraneoplastic polyarthritis, stage IV (metastatic)', as RS3PE is a specific type of paraneoplastic polyarthritis and the lung adenocarcinoma type is specified.
